name: Yeoreumui Kkeute Pineun Kkot
source:
One day, a few days before summer vacation, a girl suddenly appeared in front of me. The girl who identifies herself as a ghost suddenly asks me to get rid of her. I begin to trace the ghost girl's past through the color of death that she can see, but somehow the girl begins to melt into my daily life rather than getting closer to death...



[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1173010/?utm_source=vndb]Steam[/url]]
